name: Unit ID
remarks: RTU slave address and TCP unit ID; readable and writable, range 128–176 (0x80–0xB0); changing it does not require repeating the TCP verification

name: TCP Verification Code
remarks: write-only; the dynamic 8-character hexadecimal code from the CONOW App device details page (refreshed every 120 seconds); see [Verification code](#verification-code-modbus-tcp-direct-all-in-one-machines)

name: System Status
remarks: bit field — see the bit table below

name: Device Fault Code
remarks: [6.2 alarm bitmap](#62-device-fault-code-alarm-bitmap-1000110002); read 10001–10002 together

name: Meter Connection State
remarks: 0 = paired and connected · 1 = unpaired and not connected · 2 = paired, not connected

name: Meter Total Power
remarks: Positive = importing from grid; negative = feeding into grid

name: Grid Active Power
remarks: Positive = importing from grid / battery charging; negative = feeding into grid / battery discharging

name: Battery Work State
remarks: 0 = idle · 1 = charging · 2 = discharging; reports the actual state, not the command echo

name: Battery Power
remarks: Positive = charging; negative = discharging

name: Bypass Switch State
remarks: 0 = off · 1 = on

name: Bypass Power
remarks: Positive = discharging to bypass; negative = charging from bypass

name: Grid Voltage
remarks: phase voltage; phase A on three-phase models

name: Grid Current
remarks: Positive = importing from grid; negative = feeding into grid

name: Phase A Power
remarks: three-phase models

name: Phase B Power
remarks: three-phase models

name: Phase C Power
remarks: three-phase models

name: PV String Count
remarks: reads N = N strings supported; unsupported strings read 0

name: PV1 Energy
remarks: high word first

name: PV2 Energy
remarks: high word first

name: PV3 Energy
remarks: high word first

name: PV4 Energy
remarks: high word first

name: Battery Voltage
remarks: DC bus voltage

name: Battery Current
remarks: Positive = charging; negative = discharging

name: Cell Temp Max
remarks: signed — no offset encoding

name: Cell Temp Min
remarks: signed — no offset encoding

name: Battery Max Charge Power
remarks: currently allowed charge power; may fall below the 10100 setting when derated by temperature / SoC

name: Battery Max Discharge Power
remarks: currently allowed discharge power; may fall below the 10101 setting when derated by temperature / SoC

name: Design Capacity
remarks: battery-pack nameplate capacity

name: Remaining Capacity
remarks: current remaining battery energy

name: System Backup SoC
remarks: mirrors the written Safety SoC (10102)

name: Hardware Max AC Charge Power
remarks: device hardware ceiling, fixed at the factory, not modifiable

name: Hardware Max AC Discharge Power
remarks: device hardware ceiling, fixed at the factory, not modifiable

name: Grid-Code Export Limit
remarks: locally allowed grid-feed power limit; factory-locked to the grid-code default, = 10049 after App unlock — unlock is App-only, not writable over Modbus

name: Global AC Charge Power Limit
remarks: mirrors the written 10100

name: Global AC Discharge Power Limit
remarks: mirrors the written 10101

name: Wi-Fi Signal
remarks: always negative; for example, -60

name: Device Serial
remarks: 8 registers = 16 bytes; no single-register reads — read the whole field

name: Firmware Version
remarks: 2 registers = 4 bytes; no single-register reads — read the whole field

name: Grid Import Energy Total
remarks: read-only; monotonically increasing

name: Grid Export Energy Total
remarks: read-only; monotonically increasing

name: Meter Import Energy Total
remarks: read-only; monotonically increasing

name: Meter Export Energy Total
remarks: read-only; monotonically increasing

name: PV Energy Total

name: Battery Charge Energy Total

name: Battery Discharge Energy Total

name: Bypass Output Energy Total
remarks: read-only; monotonically increasing

name: Bypass Input Energy Total
remarks: read-only; monotonically increasing

name: AC Charge Power Limit
remarks: default 800; writable range 50 to hardware max (10048); out-of-range writes return an exception code; persists across power cycles

name: AC Discharge Power Limit
remarks: writable floor 100; writable ceiling = local grid-code export value while locked, hardware max (10049) after App unlock; persists across power cycles

name: Safety SoC
remarks: 10–100, default 20; out-of-range → Modbus exception 0x03; persists across power cycles

name: Charge/Discharge Direction
remarks: 0 = idle · 1 = charge · 2 = discharge · 3 = exit; direction 3 (exit) may be written alone with FC 0x06

name: Target Charge/Discharge Power
remarks: 0 to the limit set by 10100 / 10101; a written value above the limit is automatically written as the limit — no exception is returned

name: Charge/Discharge Cutoff SoC
remarks: safety SoC (10102) to 100; on discharge, a written value below the safety SoC is automatically written as 10102 — no exception is returned

name: Charge/Discharge Duration
remarks: 30–720; ends when either the duration or the cutoff SoC is reached first

name: Work Mode
remarks: 1 = self-consumption · 2 = manual time slots · 3 = idle; default 1; **read before write**; with a meter it follows meter power, without one it outputs the base load; persists across power cycles

name: Backup SoC
remarks: safety SoC (10102) to 100, default 40; *reserved* (backup-power mode, not supported yet); persists across power cycles

name: Allowed Reverse Power
remarks: 0 = no reverse flow; greater than 0 = allowed maximum reverse power; writable but ineffective without a connected meter; persists across power cycles

name: Allow Battery Export
remarks: 0 = forbidden · 1 = allowed; *reserved* (grid-feed mode, not supported yet); persists across power cycles

name: Bypass Always-On Switch
remarks: 0 = off · 1 = on; default off; persists across power cycles

name: Off-Grid Output Switch
remarks: 0 = off · 1 = on; default off; persists across power cycles

name: PV Curtailment Switch
remarks: 0 = off · 1 = on; default off; *reserved, not supported yet*; persists across power cycles

name: Modbus Timeout
remarks: 0–3600, 0 = disabled (default); watchdog — with no valid **write** frame for this long, the device falls back to the CONOW platform mode that was active before the Modbus service was enabled; persists across power cycles

name: Generator Switch
remarks: 0 = off · 1 = on; persists across power cycles

name: Generator Start Time
remarks: hour in the high byte (0–23), minute in the low byte (0–59); persists across power cycles

name: Generator Stop Time
remarks: hour in the high byte (0–23), minute in the low byte (0–59); persists across power cycles

name: Generator Power

name: Generator Start SoC

name: Generator Stop SoC
